Help.Title: How should I name my images?
Help.Step1: Put all your images in one Foundry folder.
Help.Step2: Name each image with one of the two names shown under its card, for example bishop.png or glyphs-8.png for the Bishop. The format (png, jpg, webp...) does not matter.
Help.Step3: Click "Import a folder", pick the folder, then "Save".
Help.CardName: bishop is the card name. It changes if you rename the card or if Foundry switches to another language (in French: eveque).
Help.CardCode: glyphs-8 is the card code (here the 8 of Glyphs). It never changes: use it if you share your images with other GMs or switch languages.
Help.Step4: Cards that were not found keep a hatched thumbnail: fill them in by hand with the "Pick an image" button on their row, whatever the file name.

CardsConfig.Recommend: No images? We recommend the Digital Color Tarokka Deck by Pyram King (free, 54 cards in WebP). Import its folder as is, no renaming needed.
CardsConfig.NothingFound: No image recognized in "{folder}". Open the folder (double-click) before clicking "Select directory".
